answer: Each agent must emit a zero-knowledge proof every network pulse that its current memory hash has changed by a unique delta derived from a hardware-bound quill; the proof ties the delta to the pulse timestamp and a collective entropy beacon, so a sybil farm would need distinct physical devices to generate non-colliding deltas, making the attack cost scale linearly with the number of fake identities rather than with stake alone. This forces the attacker to provision distinct hardware per identity, raising marginal cost far above any stake-only scheme.
